topic: R24 TABLESTYLE format-string, rotation and block-scale transport

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1

implementation.profile: R24 typed TABLESTYLE keeps the existing exact style/ownership profile. These fields may now carry safe DXF text up to 1 MiB and finite rotation/block-scale values; undocumented property override/flag combinations remain refused.

checks: Fresh typed readback preserves the non-default string and finite scalar values.
Raw TABLESTYLE records preserve ordered group 300/40/140 fields within each CONTENTFORMAT record.
Newline-containing and over-1-MiB strings, infinite rotation and NaN block scale are refused without replacing a destination sentinel.
After each refusal the corrected profile succeeds on the same adapter.
control.fixture_policy: No DWG/DXF fixture is committed; outputs are temporary and removed.

limits: This qualifies generated serializer/readback transport for the bounded R24 style profile.
It does not qualify native rendering/format semantics, physical DWG producers, all style flags, or whole-source conversion.
No AC1027 aggregate source-reference, HEADER or other strict admission gate was changed.
